items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: In fact Senator Burton from Cleveland, the Hill Burton Act

ctx.x: Yeah, after the way, ‘46, 7... And then jazz changed a lot.

One of the things I learned in medicine, this has nothing to do with this so you may want to cut this out, but I was interested in medical politics and economics and I was on a committee from the Academy of Medicine from the labor union and from the hospitals and from the insurance industry in Cleveland. At that time they were planning about things after the war, and they established the fact that the commonest age for any…
